findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses a single static hardcoded API key for all callers with no principal attribution. All consumers share the same key and cannot be distinguished.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication exists. No OAuth2 client credentials, no mTLS, no service accounts, no per-caller identity.
findings.recommendation: Replace the shared static API key with per-consumer API keys issued through AWS API Gateway with usage plans, enabling individual caller identification.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Replace shared API key with per-consumer API keys via API Gateway usage plans
blocker_remediation.target_state: Each agent/consumer has its own credential with principal attribution logged on every request

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single shared API key grants uniform access to all endpoints. No mechanism to differentiate access levels between callers.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions. All callers have identical access to GET /rates and POST /quote.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API Gateway with per-consumer API keys and usage plans that restrict endpoint access.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with per-consumer usage plans
Implement route-level middleware with permission map

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. The single API key check grants full access to all operations equally.
findings.gap: No RBAC, no ABAC, no per-action permission checks. Cannot restrict a caller to read-only access.
findings.recommendation: Implement method-level authorization via API Gateway resource policies or application middleware.

compensating_controls: API Gateway resource policies with method-level restrictions
Application middleware with action permission matrix

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: API key is hardcoded in source code. MongoDB connection string with server IP is also hardcoded. No secrets management system is used.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code with no rotation capability. Exposed to anyone with repository access and persists in git history.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Complete k8s Secret integration already referenced in deployment.yaml.

compensating_controls: Move to environment variables as interim
Deploy AWS Secrets Manager with rotation

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No request logging, no CloudTrail configuration, no CloudWatch Logs. Only a startup console.log message.
findings.gap: No audit trail for API calls. Cannot determine who called what endpoint or when.
findings.recommendation: Add structured request logging with caller identity. Configure CloudTrail with log file validation and S3 Object Lock.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, audit logging important but not deployment-blocking.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write operations requiring compliance-grade audit trails. Audit logging is still important for forensics.
compensating_controls: Enable ALB access logs to S3

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: Single shared API key with no mechanism to revoke individual identities. Revoking the key disables all consumers simultaneously.
findings.gap: No per-identity suspension mechanism. Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent.
findings.recommendation: Deploy per-consumer API keys through API Gateway enabling individual key revocation.

compensating_controls: Use API Gateway API keys with delete capability

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Logic
findings.description: No compensation or rollback logic exists. The system currently has no write operations (POST /quote is pure computation), but no compensation patterns exist if writes are added.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensation patterns before adding write operations. For current read-only scope, document the architectural decision.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, compensation important but not deployment-blocking for read-only agents.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write workflows. System has no write operations currently. Compensation is relevant for system maturity.
compensating_controls: Scope agent access to read-only operations only
Implement idempotency if writes are added

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configuration exists. MongoDB connection opens per-request with no connection pooling, no timeout, and no failure isolation.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for the MongoDB dependency. A database outage causes indefinite request hangs.
findings.recommendation: Add MongoDB connection timeout and pooling. Implement circuit breaker pattern (e.g., opossum library).

compensating_controls: Add connection timeout to MongoDB options
Implement connection pool with health checking

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. ALB forwards all traffic without throttling. No API Gateway. No application-level rate limiting middleware. No WAF rules.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops or traffic storms at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with throttling (usage plans) or add express-rate-limit middleware.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttle settings

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent frameworks cannot auto-generate tool definitions. Integration requires manual tool authoring.
findings.recommendation: Generate an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting GET /rates and POST /quote endpoints, parameters, and response schemas.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses are minimal unstructured objects: { error: 'string' }. No error codes, no retryable classification, no field-level detail.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with error_code, message, and retryable fields.

findings.title: No Pagination Support
findings.description: GET /rates supports origin/dest filters but returns all matching results via toArray() with no pagination, no limit parameter, no cursor, and no sorting.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets exhaust agent context windows.
findings.recommendation: Add limit and offset query parameters with a default maximum result size (e.g., 100 records).

findings.title: No Input Validation
findings.description: No input validation exists. Query parameters passed directly as MongoDB filter (NoSQL injection vulnerability). POST /quote does not validate numeric inputs.
findings.gap: No validation at API boundary. Vulnerable to MongoDB operator injection.
findings.recommendation: Add input validation library (joi/express-validator). Sanitize MongoDB query parameters.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: No timestamps in API responses. No created_at/updated_at fields. No Cache-Control headers. No data freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Agents cannot reason about data freshness or determine when rates were last updated.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps to rate records and return Last-Modified or X-Data-Age response headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema files, no database migrations, no changelog, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: API changes can break agent tool bindings silently with no detection mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add URL-based API versioning (/v1/rates). Introduce OpenAPI spec as schema contract.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing (no OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray). No structured logging — only startup console.log. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests are completely invisible. Cannot diagnose failures.
findings.recommendation: Add structured JSON logging with request_id correlation. Instrument with X-Ray or OpenTelemetry.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting configuration exists. No CloudWatch alarms. No monitoring integration.
findings.gap: System degradation is undetectable. No alerts for error rates or latency.
findings.recommendation: Create CloudWatch alarms on ALB 5xx rate and target response time.

findings.title: Partial Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: CloudFormation template exists for ALB and S3 bucket but lacks governance controls (no PR review gates, no drift detection, no AWS Config rules).
findings.gap: IaC exists without change control or drift monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Enforce PR review on infrastructure/ changes. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via SSH (forever restart). No contract testing.
findings.gap: No automated testing or deployment. API-breaking changes not caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI pipeline with contract tests. Deploy via prepared k8s manifests.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual git pull + forever restart on single EC2. No blue/green, no canary.
findings.gap: No fast recovery path for broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Deploy on Kubernetes using prepared k8s manifests for kubectl rollout undo capability.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files. No test framework in dependencies. Zero test coverage.
findings.gap: No automated API tests. Behavior changes undetectable.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests with jest + supertest for GET /rates and POST /quote.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: S3 bucket has no encryption configuration. MongoDB encryption at rest not configured.
findings.gap: Data at rest (rate cards in S3, rates in MongoDB) is unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Enable S3 default encryption (SSE-KMS). Migrate to DocumentDB or enable MongoDB encryption.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment configured. Dockerfile allows local execution but no production-equivalent staging exists.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior with realistic data.
findings.recommendation: Create staging namespace in k8s with seeded test data.

findings.title: Idempotency — Informational (Read-Only Scope)
findings.description: POST /quote is a pure computation with no side effects. GET /rates is inherently idempotent. Under read-only scope, idempotency is informational only.
findings.gap: No formal idempotency key support, but not needed for current read-only scope.
findings.recommendation: Plan idempotency support if write endpoints are added.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: agent_scope=read-only, idempotency informational only.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write operations, so idempotency is informational.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit headers returned in API responses. No rate limit documentation.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on remaining capacity.
findings.recommendation: Include X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers when rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation (Data-Gateway — Low Impact)
findings.description: No identity propagation. No JWT, no token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows. Downgraded to INFO for data-gateway archetype serving reference data.
findings.gap: No identity context in requests.
findings.recommendation: Low priority for reference-data service. Implement if user-specific data is added.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits (Read-Only Scope)
findings.description: No transaction limits exist. Under read-only scope, agents cannot modify records, so blast radius limits are informational.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operations.
findings.recommendation: Plan transaction limits if write endpoints are added.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification — Not Applicable
findings.description: System stores shipping rates (origin, destination, pricing) — reference/business data. No PII, PHI, financial instruments, or credentials stored or processed.
findings.gap: No data classification needed for current data model.
findings.recommendation: Reassess if data model expands to include regulated data.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: Stage A = No — not a data-handling target.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System stores shipping rates (reference data). No PII/PHI/financial/credential data present.

b1.reasoning: Stage A = No. Not a data-handling target.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality monitoring, profiling, or completeness metrics for the rates collection.
findings.gap: No quality score or completeness metric. Rate card freshness depends on nightly upload.
findings.recommendation: Monitor rate card upload success and data completeness.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer describes the rates collection or its semantic meaning.
findings.gap: Data model must be inferred from source code.
findings.recommendation: Document rates collection schema in README or API spec.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes REST endpoints via Express (GET /rates, POST /quote). Integration does not require direct database access or UI automation.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses are JSON via Express res.send() with objects. Well-structured for LLM consumption.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Event Emission for State Changes
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — data-gateway archetype has no state changes.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: GET /rates provides queryable access to current shipping rates via MongoDB queries with filter parameters.

evaluations.title: Concurrency Controls
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — agent_scope is read-only.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority set and not confirmed on critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — agent_scope is read-only.

evaluations.title: Configurable Approval Gates
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — agent_scope is read-only.

evaluations.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
evaluations.reason: Shipping rates are business reference data not subject to residency or sovereignty requirements. No regulated personal data.

evaluations.title: PII Redaction in Logs
evaluations.reason: System handles no PII (shipping rates are reference data). No request-level logging exists that could leak user data.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful: origin, dest, weight, zone, quote, error. Minor abbreviation (dest) is widely understood.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve the AUTH-Q1 BLOCKER (machine identity) and address critical safety risks: scoped permissions, audit logging, rate limiting, and resilience patterns.
Improve agent effectiveness: add API specification, input validation, pagination, observability, CI/CD pipeline, and staging environment.
Address informational findings and remaining quality improvements: test coverage, documentation, and future-proofing for write operations.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with per-consumer identity and throttling
recommended_actions.rationale: Resolves the BLOCKER (machine identity) and simultaneously addresses scoped permissions, action-level auth, identity suspension, and rate limiting.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded credentials in source code are a security vulnerability and block credential rotation.

recommended_actions.action: Add structured logging and CloudTrail audit trail
recommended_actions.rationale: Enables audit trail for all API operations and provides diagnostic capability for agent-initiated requests.

recommended_actions.action: Implement CI/CD pipeline and deploy on Kubernetes
recommended_actions.rationale: Kubernetes manifests already prepared. Enables automated deployment, rollback, and staging environments.

recommended_actions.action: Generate OpenAPI specification and add input validation
recommended_actions.rationale: Enables automated tool generation, structured error handling, and protects against injection attacks.
